summary: V1 Cleanup Testing Complete - All V1 endpoints removed, V2 APIs working correctly. Backend: 17/17 tests passed. Frontend: All features verified working.

Public /api/bot-info/{bot_id} endpoint works correctly without authentication - returns bot name and persona
V2 LLM config endpoints working: GET/PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/llm-config and POST .../test
V2 bot settings endpoints working: GET/PUT /api/v2/orgs/{org_id}/bots/{bot_id}/settings
Frontend BotSettings.js correctly uses v2.getLlmConfig, v2.putLlmConfig, v2.testLlmConfig, v2.getBotSettings, v2.updateBotSettings
Frontend ChatPage.js and ChatWidget.js correctly use /api/bot-info/{id} instead of removed /admin/bot-config
Frontend KnowledgeBase.js correctly uses v2.listBots for sharing modal
Save as Template button visible and functional on Bot Settings page
All sidebar navigation links present and clickable
